attribution: Derived from Sudars et al. (2020), Data in Brief 31:105833, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2020.105833
domain_review_reason: Kaggle description states the images were augmented (90-degree rotations, shear, brightness) from an upstream field dataset, but does not state that the source images were field-captured. A vision-model sample read 14/18 cells as open-field and 4/18 as ambiguous close-ups, which is not enough to confirm a uniform field label. It is also a derivative of the registered Ronin source, so it is not counted as a new source.
